title: Erlang/OTP 26 no longer receives security updates
summary: Erlang/OTP supports the last three major releases with security updates. OTP 26 left that window when OTP 29 shipped on 2026-05-13, so the release no longer receives security updates from the Erlang/OTP project.

constraints: Keep .tool-versions erlang pins, asdf elixir …-otp-N suffixes, CI setup-beam OTP versions, and container images on one supported OTP release that the project's Elixir supports.
Confirm Mix dependencies and NIFs build on the target OTP and recompile after changing the runtime.

steps.title: Raise the Erlang/OTP version
steps.instructions: Change the reported declaration from OTP 26 to a supported release (see the replacement), using the project's existing version manager.

steps.title: Align other OTP version surfaces
steps.instructions: Update .tool-versions, asdf elixir …-otp-N pins, CI setup-beam OTP versions, and Dockerfile erlang images so they agree.

verification.purpose: Confirm the active OTP release is the intended major.
Re-resolve dependencies and compile on the new OTP.
Run the Mix test suite on the new OTP.
